sentences.en: My homestay parents tried to speak to me in French.
sentences.zh: 我的寄宿家庭父母试图用法语和我说话。

sentences.en: In order to qualify for the homestay you must have an interview with the sponsors.
sentences.zh: 为了符合寄宿条件，你必须与赞助人进行面试。

sentences.en: One of the "homestay" Japanese students in my Lulu Island home liked to play ice hockey.
sentences.zh: 在我鲁卢岛家中的一个‘寄宿’日本学生喜欢打冰球。

senses.zh: (在国外的访问者)在当地居民家居住的时期。
